description: Circuit byte-stability + replay guard. CircuitId = BLAKE3-256(SHARENET/CIRCUIT/ID/1 || route_id || initiator_x25519_pubkey). Per-hop AEAD keys are HKDF-SHA256-extracted from the X25519 shared secret, expanded with info = SHARENET/CIRCUIT/KEY/1 || u8(hopIndex) || circuit_id. Nonce layout = 4-byte route_id_prefix (BE) || 8-byte sequence (BE). Replay model = ORDERED_STREAM (strictly increasing, no out-of-order window).

vectors.name: circuit-id-deterministic
vectors.description: deriveCircuitId(routeId, initiatorX25519PublicKey) MUST produce a byte-stable 32-byte BLAKE3-256 output. The routeId here is the V-ROUTE-COMMIT-001 single-hop commitment root so the vectors cross-reference.

vectors.name: hop-keys-deterministic
vectors.description: deriveHopKeys(sharedSecret, hopIndex, circuitId) MUST produce byte-stable 32-byte forwarding + return keys via HKDF-SHA256. info = utf8(SHARENET/CIRCUIT/KEY/1) || u8(hopIndex) || circuitId.

vectors.name: nonce-layout
vectors.description: buildNonce(routeIdPrefix, sequenceNumber) returns 12 bytes: bytes 0-3 = u32be(routeIdPrefix), bytes 4-11 = u64be(sequenceNumber). The route_id_prefix binds the nonce to a specific circuit; the sequence number provides per-circuit replay protection.

vectors.name: replay-guard-rejects-duplicate
vectors.description: ORDERED_STREAM replay model: a fresh guard accepts checkAndRecord(1n). A second checkAndRecord(1n) (same sequence) MUST fail because seq ≤ highestSeq.

vectors.name: replay-guard-rejects-lower
vectors.description: ORDERED_STREAM replay model: checkAndRecord(5n) succeeds (highestSeq = 5). A subsequent checkAndRecord(3n) MUST fail because 3n ≤ 5n. There is no out-of-order / sliding-window acceptance (gap tolerance = 0).

verification: Reference implementation: reference/circuit/circuit.ts — deriveCircuitId, deriveHopKeys, buildNonce, CircuitReplayGuard.
notes: The fixed X25519 public key in circuit-id-deterministic is a deterministic test value — it is NOT the public half of any seed in this repo, and it is not used for ECDH. The sharedSecret in hop-keys-deterministic is a deterministic test value, not the output of any specific ECDH operation.
